caption: The drawing depicts a lidded vessel, likely a sugar bowl or tureen, with two large curved handles on each side. The main body of the vessel is oval and vertically fluted at the lower half, transitioning to a smooth upper section adorned with detailed floral engravings and a monogram featuring the intertwined letters "LHC" at its center. The fitted lid has a rounded, domed shape topped with a decorative finial in the form of a pinecone, which is colored green and attached with a base of stylized leaves. The rest of the drawing is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting a metallic surface, possibly silver. The handles have rolled ends and are symmetrically positioned. The artist's name, "L. Drozdout," is written in the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
